profile.name: Evita
profile.title: Junior Unity Game Developer
profile.introduction: I’m a Junior Unity Game Developer who loves creating worlds and turning game ideas into playable prototypes. I enjoy experimenting with gameplay, building in Unity and C#, and learning through both personal projects and team game jams. Outside of game development, I love travelling and summer — discovering new places, spending time by the sea, and bringing a little of that feeling into the worlds I make.
profile.about: I’m Evita, a Unity developer based in Prague and an MSc student in Gaming & Multimedia Application Development. I work on the parts that make a game feel alive: how a character moves, how a puzzle responds, and how a level comes together. My background in STEM education and e-learning also draws me to games that help people explore and learn. Some of these worlds are mine; others were made with a team. I share my own part in each project.

projects.title: Nostos
projects.tagline: A Greek summer album, brought to life.
projects.summary: A solo-developed 2D Unity platformer through Amorgos and Mani. Run, jump, and swim through two Greek landscapes, collect shells and olives, and gradually unlock a summer photo album.
projects.description: I developed Nostos entirely on my own. It is an atmospheric 2D journey through two places in Greece. The Amorgos level pairs coastal platforming and swimming with seashell collection and sea-urchin hazards. The Mani level introduces a more rugged Mediterranean landscape, olives, and environmental hazards. Progress unlocks photographs and memories, connecting exploration with a visual summer album. Originally developed as AegeanMemories, the project is now released as Nostos and playable in the browser.
projects.role: Solo developer · Unity development & game design
projects.highlight: Developed the entire game independently: gameplay, level design, collectible progression, and the photo-memory album.
contributions: Developed running, jumping, and swimming for exploration across land and underwater areas.
Created distinct Amorgos and Mani levels with seashell and olive collectibles and environmental hazards.
Connected collectible progression with photograph unlocks, memory overlays, and the summer album interface.
Published the completed Unity game as a playable HTML5 experience on itch.io.

projects.title: The Gold Thief: An Elven Heist
projects.tagline: A little thief. A loyal dog. One daring heist.
projects.summary: My 3D Unity stealth game set in a colourful elven village. Collect gold, slip past patrols, and use a dog distraction to escape before dawn.
projects.description: Sneak through a low-poly village, gather gold, and escape before the countdown reaches dawn. Guards watch their surroundings, running makes noise, and a loyal dog can create the opening you need. The gameplay recording shows patrol sight cones, hidden and spotted states, a map, the gold counter, and the final escape result.
projects.highlight: A stealth adventure built around gold collection, guard patrols, and a dog distraction.
contributions: Developed this game as an individual Unity project.
Brought together the village exploration, stealth encounters, gold collection, and escape flow shown in the gameplay demo.

projects.title: Aegean Escape VR
projects.tagline: Two rooms. Hands-on puzzles. One way out.
projects.summary: A short Unity VR escape room inspired by the Aegean, with object interaction, key discovery, and an object-placement puzzle.
projects.description: Explore two rooms, use virtual hands to interact with objects, discover the correct key, and solve a placement puzzle to escape. The experience combines VR movement and teleportation with grabbing, timed puzzle progression, sound feedback, and replay functionality.
projects.highlight: XR locomotion, object grabbing, puzzle progression, and completion/replay flow.
contributions: Developed a Unity VR escape-room experience with XR Interaction Toolkit.
Integrated locomotion, teleportation, virtual-hand interactions, and object grabbing.
Connected key discovery and object-placement puzzles with a timer, sound feedback, and replay functionality.

projects.title: Cat Crawler?
projects.tagline: Follow the cat. Think outside the boxes.
projects.summary: A team-made Unity puzzle game where a cat moves through neighbouring boxes in search of a mouse. Created for Bad Ideas Game Jam 2026.
projects.description: Guide a cat through a grid of boxes and search for its target. Move into a neighbouring box with a mouse click and use E to eat its contents. The game was created by a four-person team and is available as a Windows download.
projects.highlight: Tile and item interaction scripts, exit outcomes, and the timed final reveal.
contributions: Worked on the tile scripts, including empty, action, and exit tiles, and the shared item interaction code.
Connected exit-tile behaviour to the player’s state and the game’s win or lose outcome.
Refined the final reveal sequence with timed box closing and reopening and the cat or mouse outcome.

projects.title: Letters To The Sea
projects.tagline: A message in a bottle. A journey across the waves.
projects.summary: A top-down 3D Unity game about guiding a bottle across a dangerous sea to reach land. A six-person team project for Game Off 2025.
projects.description: A stranded islander sends a letter out to sea. Guide the bottle through the waves toward another island using WASD or the arrow keys. This prototype was the team’s first game-jam collaboration and interprets the theme of waves through the ocean journey and its unfolding letters.
projects.highlight: Island terrain, vegetation placement, materials, and rock prefab setup.
contributions: Created and refined island terrain and adjusted its colours in Unity.
Added palm trees and seaweed to the environment.
Imported rock assets, created materials, and prepared rock prefabs for the scene.
